description: Camera limit removal: raises the pitch ceiling to 89.0 degrees (allows a level view without tilting past horizontal) and sets the camera distance/height bounds MinTilesVisible to 1.5 (was 3.0) and MaxTilesVisible to 20.0 (unchanged). Patches the MaxPitch immediate in the exe's native .text and recomputes the PE checksum; edits two floats in the blueprint CDO. All edits are equal-length with no layout change and are reversible byte for byte. Only this manifest and the patcher are distributed; no original binaries are included.
rollback: exe_patcher.py restore (restores each target from its adjacent .bak-<UTC> file)

_notes.max_pitch_deg: Upper pitch bound in degrees. Vanilla: 30; 89 is near-horizontal; <= 90 prevents looking from below. Use 60/75 for a more conservative setting.
_notes.min_tiles_visible: Lower camera distance/height bound (blueprint CDO). Vanilla: 3.0; lower values move the camera closer/lower. Try 1.0 or 0.5.
_notes.max_tiles_visible: Upper camera distance/height bound. Vanilla: 20.0; increase to zoom out farther.
_notes.how_to_test: After editing this file, rebuild the payload, apply the camera rule in a clean sandbox, then verify in-game. Restore with the sandbox restore command or exe_patcher.py restore.
